art_direction.shape_language: Curved glass contrasts with a square cube and articulated metal joints, preserving each silhouette.
art_direction.focal_hierarchy: Gripping contact and clearance around the glass lead. The route is secondary and labels appear after the action.
art_direction.motion_language: Finite contact and travel windows accelerate and brake on the authored clock; stable cameras preserve the cube and glass.

hero.finish: Thick contact pads, metal rings and fasteners, cube bevels, glass rim thickness and grounded shadows keep the hardware readable.

action_proposals.visible_action: An illustrated gripper carries a block beside fragile glass. A proposed path bends toward demonstrated routes before the corrected move executes.
action_proposals.consequence: A proposed reusable learned safety filter will be evaluated in physical robot experiments, including pick-and-place near fragile objects.
action_proposals.limits: Illustration of proposed research. No actual robot, learned model output, measured failure rate or proven accident prevention is depicted.
